name: Herald
author: sai80082
description: Turns arriving mail into the notification you actually wanted: one-time codes (OTP / 2FA / verification codes) set large and one click from the clipboard, bank and card transaction alerts with the amount and merchant, and security warnings — classified by any OpenAI-compatible endpoint over plain IMAP. Not a mail client: it never shows you your inbox.

barWidget.description: Mail glyph that wakes up when something actionable arrives. Click for recent one-time codes, transactions, and security alerts, with click-to-copy and the watcher's connection state.

schema.label: Badge count
schema.description: Which unread events put a count next to the glyph.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is waiting
schema.description: Take the glyph out of the bar entirely until an unread event arrives.

schema.label: Rows in the panel
schema.description: How many recent events the panel lists.
